positions.name: RollbackReadiness
positions.frame: what establishes that a rollback capability is actually real?
positions.why: src-1 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals as the operational cadence; src-2 asserts that an unrehearsed rollback is effectively nonexistent. Together they cohere under the question of what makes rollback preparedness genuine — the directive supplies the practice, the assertion supplies the principle that practice is constitutive of the capability.
